text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pushing past her limits after a fierce 
contest with Sakura Chiyono O and the 
others, Mejiro Ardan brilliantly claims 
victory in the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the afterglow of victory, 
Mejiro Ardan realized she had forgotten 
her goal of surpassing her elder sister's 
legacy, leading her to a profound 
realization.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her revelation was this: putting 
everything into competing with cherished 
rivals like Sakura Chiyono O was precisely 
what made her own running shine even 
brighter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Deeply grateful for the rivals who helped 
her reach new heights, Mejiro Ardan 
stepped forward into a brand-new realm...!
